scenes.headline: How Pipette measures a model's speed on a phone
scenes.sub: Liquid AI's lab-verified dataset of 1,000+ on-device configurations.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Canyon! Pipette benchmarks models on phones and laptops. Here's how it measures, and why it won't rank.

scenes.text: A speed number belongs to a deployment: model, quantization, runtime, device and context. Pipette measures all five together, with the conditions attached.
scenes.say: The idea: speed belongs to a deployment. Model, quantization, runtime, device and context. Change any one and the number moves, so Pipette pins all five.

scenes.title: From a device to a checkable record

steps.say: A catalog service hands benchmarks to a client app on the device: a MacBook, an iPhone, a Galaxy phone.
Each submission records every condition: token shape, model file, quantization, runtime, device and operating system.
Quality is graded on the same quantized files, by a scorer that never sees which model wrote what. Then every raw record is published.

items.say: A heat and load check before every timed run.
Five measured repetitions. Only passing runs are published.

scenes.title: Decode speed kept, 256 to 4,096 input tokens
scenes.note: Q4_K_M on a Galaxy S26 Ultra
scenes.say: Same size, same phone. As the prompt grows, the hybrid keeps seventy-eight point four percent of its decode speed. The plain model, thirty-three point eight.

scenes.title: Why the hybrid holds up
scenes.text: decode cost per token = a + b·f·L
scenes.say: Full attention reads every earlier token. A fixed-state layer doesn't.

parts.note: share of layers on full attention
parts.say: F is the share of layers on full attention. For the hybrid, it fits at about zero point one two five.

left.title: A ranked list
items: so the list calls them a tie
left.say: Two eight-billion-parameter models tie on speed and memory, within two point four percent.

right.title: A constraints panel
right.say: Yet one leads instruction following by seven point three points, the other science reasoning by fourteen. So Pipette asks for your constraint.

scenes.text: On-device behaviour is a property of the deployed system, not of the model in isolation.

recap: Five axes pinned for every number
Heat checks, five repetitions, blind scoring
Hybrids hold their speed as context grows
scenes.say: To recap: five axes behind every number, a careful protocol, and a benchmark that asks before it answers.
